segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Behind the workbench, you spot a vertical maintenance shaft. An old iron ladder runs straight up through the rock, leading toward a faint square of snowy moonlight high above.

segments.speaker: hero
segments.text: Up the ladder!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you shout.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You and Pip scramble up the iron rungs as fast as you can. You climb past the thundering, frozen waterwheel shaft, bursting through an old sheet-metal trapdoor out onto the pitched roof of the Old Mill!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: The freezing mountain wind hits you like a slap. Snow is falling thick and heavy across the wooden shingles.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: You scramble up to the roof peak—and stop dead in your tracks.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Down in the courtyard below, the mill is completely surrounded.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Dozens of Nutcracker soldiers on clockwork horses have ringed the building. Their brass searchlights sweep across the snowy roof, pinning you and Pip in a blinding crossfire of white light.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: SURRENDER THE C.M. JOURNAL!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: a loudspeaker horn blares from the ground.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: THERE IS NO ESCAPE FROM FESTIVE ORDER!

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: We're trapped,

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: you pant, looking at the forty-foot drop into the frozen river.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Pip, there's nowhere to go!

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Nonsense!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip declared, puffing out his coat and reaching into his inner pocket with supreme, triumphant flair.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Master Detective Pip never enters a hornets' nest without an aerial tactical evacuation strategy!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: He pulled out a heavy brass whistle shaped like an acorn.

segments.speaker: pip
segments.text: Behold! The Emergency Sky-Howler! I am about to summon Everfrost's most ferocious aerial transport operative! A creature of raw power, iron discipline, and blood-curdling sky-courage!

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Pip put the whistle to his lips and blew with all his might.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: No sound came out. Just a high-pitched, ultrasonic hiss that made your teeth vibrate.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: For five seconds, nothing happened.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Then, the snowy clouds directly above the mill began to glow.
